items.title: Step-up authentication: how to right-size authentication to risk
items.summary: Not every action a user takes in an application carries the same risk. Viewing an account balance in a banking application isn’t the same as wiring several thousand dollars to a new payee. In practice, though, many applications ask users to prove their identity once at sign-in and then treat every action the same from […]
